basic_details.job_title: NEHU Project Technical Support–III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU) has announced 3 vacancies for the Project Technical Support–III post on a contract basis for an ICMR-funded project. The engagement is initially for 1 year, extendable up to completion of project subject to performance and funds, and is co-terminus with the project with a pay of Rs. 28,000 + HRA as admissible. Candidates applying for the position require a Graduate degree in B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering (BME)/Information Technology (IT)/ Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), or MCA from a recognized university. content_sections.heading: NEHU Project Technical Support–III at a Glance

rows.details: Development and Prospective Multicentric Validation of an AI-Based Model for Automated Airway Assessment and Difficult Airway Prediction
Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in B.E./B.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering (BME)/Information Technology (IT)/ Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), or MCA from a recognized university. Desirable Skills: Candidates with knowledge or technical experience in AI tool development, mobile application development, graphical user interface (GUI) development, image processing, and handling photographic equipment will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹28,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible. The appointment is temporary and co-terminus with the project, initially lasting for 1 year and extendable up to the completion of the 4-year project based on satisfactory performance and available funds.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEHU Project Technical Support–III
content_sections.text: Email your Curriculum Vitae along with supporting self-attested documents to [email protected] . Use the subject line “Application for the Post of Project Technical Support–III for the ICMR funded project” in the email. Complete the required Google Form available at https://forms.gle/LPobW4zDjUpxhWjP9. Ensure the email includes self-attested copies of your Curriculum Vitae, Educational Qualification Certificates, Experience Certificates (if applicable), Proof of Date of Birth, and NOC from employer/HoD (if applicable). Submit all applications on or before 19 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified for the interview via email only. The interview will be conducted in an in-person (offline) mode at NEHU Shillong or the designated project site. Candidates must produce original certificates and mark sheets during the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: These positions are temporary and co-terminus with the ICMR-funded project. The appointment is initially for 1 year, and extendable up to the completion of the 4-year project subject to satisfactory performance and project funds.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive a monthly remuneration of ₹28,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted and notified for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be notified for the interview exclusively via email. The interview will be held in person (offline).

faq.question: Q4. What subject line should be used when emailing the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must use the exact subject line “Application for the Post of Project Technical Support–III for the ICMR funded project” when emailing their CV and documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Do working professionals require any special document to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, working professionals and candidates pursuing any course must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their respective Head of Department.
